title: Los Angeles Half-Day Private City Tour with Celebrity Homes
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: The hours of the tour include travel time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Two tours in One! LA's iconic sites PLUS celebrity homes in one tour. Choose this super flexible 1/2 day tour to opt in or out of any of the sites or even request your own wish list. Avoid being tied down to a rigid schedule and cramped in with dozens of other tourists. In the hands of a state-certified, professional, and personable driver, you will be transported in a private and comfortable SUV for your small group of up to 6 passengers to visit the most iconic sites of Los Angeles like Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Venice & more along with celebrity homes on the way. Your driver will be knowledgeable in the locations for the best photo opportunities and even show you extra sites usually not covered by other tours. Hotel pickup and drop-off included. (Order of stops depends on pickup location).
